body.message:
Dear Afifa,

I am writing to share my feedback regarding my current stay with fäm Living (Confirmation: 614213068).

First, I must point out that your contact details appear to be entirely non-functional: the email address provided (complaints@famliving.com) bounced back as nonexistent, and the phone number (+971521750940) is unavailable and not registered on WhatsApp.

I have been in Dubai for nearly a month and a half, switching accommodations every two weeks across various hosts, and your property is my 4th stay. My previous hosts were exceptionally proactive—they would regularly message to check if anything was missing and ensured complete guest satisfaction. Unfortunately, your team's behavior has been irresponsible, and the experience here has fallen well below standard:

1. Pre-Arrival & Deposit: I booked the night before check-in, with no deposit mentioned on Booking.com. Just as I was packed and ready to leave, I was suddenly called and told check-in wouldn't be allowed without paying a deposit—something I have not encountered with any other host.

2. Communication & AI Replies: Every inquiry was met with automated AI replies stating your working hours (9 AM to 9 PM) and asserting that no response could be provided outside those hours. Only after persistent pushing did I get brief two-word responses. I didn't receive my room details until very close to the check-in time.

3. Check-in Delay: Upon arrival, I was kept waiting for nearly an hour because proper internal coordinations were not made in advance.

4. Unit & Basic Amenities: The amenities inside the unit are strictly "economy class" at best:
- Appliances are outdated; I found noodle remnants inside the electric kettle when trying to make tea on day one.
- The microwave is too small to fit the very plates provided in the kitchen.
- The oven lacks suitable baking/oven dishes.
- Basic essentials like a kitchen sponge, disposable slippers, or toothbrushes were entirely missing. 
- When I requested these basic items, I was simply told that you do not provide them at all and could only offer extra towels.
- ⁠5- Also, for a two-week stay, you should have proactively provided complimentary cleaning services without me even needing to ask.
Guests should not be expected to purchase basic living essentials, nor should they deal with such unresponsive service. I am scheduled to stay for two weeks and was actually planning to extend for another week, but given these conditions and the lack of proper support, I honestly do not know how to proceed. 

I hope this detailed feedback helps you address these service and operational gaps.

Best regards,
Sima Jafarpanah
